stage: actual selected-dispatch Vulkan import and binding provenance; replay incomplete
capture_scope: One isolated occurrence-64 compute diagnostic; selected buffer and image catalog, not all Vulkan objects.

independent_canonical_interval_review.method: Map each bind edge through the recorded Vulkan memory lifetime and offset; external imports additionally map through the validated original host backing lease. Clip padded sparse tails to true resource extents. Preserve distinct VMA memory lifetimes and suballocation offsets.
independent_canonical_interval_review.generation_scope: All 64 external leases validate successfully at a shared current backing generation. Complete recorded host events show no overlapping invalidation after acquisition. Disjoint generation advancement is accepted by status and interval history, not by equating guest addresses.
independent_canonical_interval_review.meaning: No declared canonical segments overlap in this capture. Absence of overlap does not exercise overlapping-alias payload agreement or prove alias correctness for other captures.

limitations: Successful binding and host-lease validation establish provenance only for the enumerated selected catalog at its recorded boundaries; they do not attest all Vulkan objects or all resource reachability.
The host registry observes mapping/discard changes and preserves discard behavior. Its generations and valid leases do not detect arbitrary CPU content writes or write-and-restore interference.
Per-lease validation and host-event collection are not an atomic content snapshot, writer barrier, or lock held through publication.
Zero overlapping canonical segments makes overlapping-alias payload comparison vacuous in this run. Mirrors and shadows retain independent memory identities.
Complete device feature and float-control state, temporal dependencies, submitted descriptor interpretation and independent output comparison remain separate gates.
No isolated shader-replay execution, frozen-input replay, historical full-dispatch replay, rendering equivalence or FPS improvement is established by this observation.
Older allocation/image manifests retain their original conservative component flags; this joined observation does not relabel them complete replay.
